name: Hugging Face Diffusers Open-Source Library
free_limit: Apache-2.0 Python library for local diffusion-model inference and training pipelines for images, video and audio; no software license fee or per-inference quota imposed by the library.
watch_out: Model checkpoints have separate licenses, usage restrictions and sometimes gated access; check each model before commercial use. GPUs, cloud compute, model downloads and hosted inference APIs are not free with this library.
